Best RTX 3050 (4GB vs 6GB) Laptops in India: The TGP & VRAM Trap

NVIDIA quietly released an updated RTX 3050 with 6GB VRAM and a 96-bit bus, replacing the older 4GB / 128-bit variant. In modern titles like Hogwarts Legacy and The Last of Us, 4GB VRAM causes severe stuttering, while 6GB plays smoothly.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

Always prioritize 6GB RTX 3050 laptops like the Lenovo LOQ 15 (95W TGP) or Acer Nitro V 15. Avoid low-wattage 45W 4GB variants unless portability is your only concern.
